description.value:
When unarmored and unencumbered, the monk adds his Wisdom bonus (if any) to his AC and his CMD. In addition, a monk gains a +1 bonus to AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every four monk levels thereafter, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the monk is flat-footed. He loses these bonuses when he is immobilized or helpless, when he wears any armor, when he carries a shield, or when he carries a medium or heavy load.

Granted by Monk at level 1, Monk (Unchained) at level 1 (Foundry classAssociations; PCGen cr_abilities_class.lst:174, pu_abilities_class.lst:155). Its 10 everythingpath/ increments (monk-ac-bonus, unchained-monk-ac-bonus-N) take this assessment through attributionFrom; each increment's name was checked against its class table's row. Required notices PZO1110, PZO1131, all reviewed with no hold in force. The sheet's missing calculations stay outstanding with the launch row's owner, never legal holds.

mechanicsReview.name: AC Bonus (MNK)
mechanicsReview.descriptionText:
When unarmored and unencumbered, the monk adds his Wisdom bonus (if any) to his AC and his CMD. In addition, a monk gains a +1 bonus to AC and CMD at 4th level. This bonus increases by 1 for every four monk levels thereafter, up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the monk is flat-footed. He loses these bonuses when he is immobilized or helpless, when he wears any armor, when he carries a shield, or when he carries a medium or heavy load.
